1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Two translations, three rods, wide visible tip rings, generous actuator power.
1.natural_language: Steer one rigid colored rod assembly until every colored tip center lies inside its matching ring in FRONT, SIDE and TOP. Start with IGNITE FOUNDRY; the dies then move independently of your controls. Simultaneous fit builds fusion; lost fit drains it. Build full fusion, then CERTIFY CASTING. An early submission or an unfused 90-second run ends the episode. Preparation is safe; there is no in-game stop, reset or retry. Drag the round gantry handles; the small cyan ticks show the moving physical gantry. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
